server_network: Qualified app/database are on the project internal Docker network; no outbound network and cron0. Optional IAP/rpc/base_import_module/web_unsplash implementations are excluded by the curated addon allowlist.
limits: Static retained-source classification, not a claim that every browser can never follow an external link.
